title: I don't like this soup, Dad.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: I don't like this soup, Dad.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: But you loved this soup last week!

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: It's too salty now. And I don't like the little green bits.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: The green bits are just tiny pieces of spinach.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Try it with a piece of bread. Bread makes the salty taste smaller.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Okay... Mmm! It's not too salty anymore!

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: See? Now eat it all up, big tiger.
